memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  Status: Episodes of spinning lasting <1 min, triggered by head movement, Dix-Hallpike pending.
  Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg BD; meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute vertigo; arrange Dix-Hallpike and audiometry.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  Status: Asymptomatic, BMI 24, waist 88 cm (<90 cm cut‑off).
  Plan: Start silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; order LFT, lipid profile, platelet count, abdominal ultrasound.
- General
  Weight 78 kg, waist 88 cm (acceptable).
  Diet advice: Breakfast – low‑fat idli with sambar; Lunch – mixed vegetable ragi roti; Dinner – grilled fish with steamed greens.
  Due: Next HbA1c 2025-07-05 (routine).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Betahistine 16 mg BD, 30 days
Meclizine 25 mg SOS, 10 tablets
Silymarin 140 mg TDS, 30 days
Rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, 30 days

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
ALT 34 U/L (≤40), AST 30 U/L (≤38), ALKP 78 U/L (≤120), GGT 22 U/L (≤50)
Total cholesterol 190 mg/dL (<200), LDL 110 mg/dL (<130), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 150 mg/dL (<150)
Platelet count 212 x10^9/L (150‑400)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: Liver shows diffuse hyperechogenicity consistent with grade II hepatic steatosis, spleen normal, no focal lesion, portal vein patent.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Dix‑Hallpike test: Positive on right side with torsional nystagmus, latency 2 sec, duration <15 sec – consistent with right posterior canal BPPV.
Audiometry (pure tone): Bilateral thresholds within normal limits (0‑25 dB HL).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have felt dizzy twice yesterday when turning my head to the right while getting out of bed. The spinning lasted about 10 seconds and then stopped. No nausea or hearing change. I took meclizine once and felt better.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  Status: No vertigo episodes in past 6 weeks after betahistine; meclizine used only once.
  Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD; consider tapering if symptom‑free another month.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  Status: ALT improved to 28 U/L; waist unchanged 88 cm.
  Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS; rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; repeat LFT in 3 months.
- General
  Weight 77.5 kg, waist 88 cm (acceptable).
  Diet advice: Breakfast – oats with milk and fruit; Lunch – quinoa salad with chickpeas; Dinner – lentil soup with steamed vegetables.
  Due: Next HbA1c 2025-10-06.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Audiometry repeat: Bilateral hearing thresholds 0‑20 dB HL, no significant change from baseline.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  Status: Vertigo‑free for 3 months; betahistine tapered off 2 weeks ago, no recurrence.
  Plan: Discontinue betahistine; keep meclizine SOS for any future acute episode.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  Status: ALT 22 U/L; lipid profile shows LDL 95 mg/dL.
  Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS; consider reducing rosuvastatin to 2.5 mg OD given LDL <100.
- General
  Weight 77 kg, waist 86 cm (acceptable).
  Diet advice: Breakfast – wheat dosa with coconut chutney; Lunch – brown rice with sambar and vegetables; Dinner – grilled chicken with steamed broccoli.
  Due: Next HbA1c 2026-01-02.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Dr S. Rao, Gastroenterology, for NAFLD assessment and possible fibrosis scoring (FibroScan).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterology opinion: NAFLD grade II, FibroScan shows F0‑F1 fibrosis. Recommend lifestyle continuation, repeat LFT in 6 months, no pharmacologic therapy needed at present.
